notes.title: Demo is releasing on September 26th
notes.notes:
[p][b]Horus: Desert Survivor[/b] is ready to spread its wings, the [b]demo launches on September 26th[/b]![/p][p]Step into mythological Egypt as Horus, battling through endless hordes of corrupted gods, monsters, and beasts. Build your deck of divine weapons, discover powerful upgrades, and carve your path of vengeance.[/p][p]This demo will give you a first taste of the fast-paced survivor-like combat fused with the deep strategy of deckbuilding.[/p][p][b]Demo Release Date:[/b] September 26
Wishlist now and be ready to fight the corruption![/p]

notes.title: Demo Prep Underway!
notes.notes:
[p][b]Hey everyone,[/b][/p][p]Just a quick update from the desert![/p][p]We’re hard at work preparing for the [i]Horus: Desert Survivor[/i] [b]demo launch this summer[/b]. It’s shaping up to be a big one — here’s a peek at what’s coming:[/p][p][b]Your Beta Feedback[/b]
We’ve taken your suggestions to heart. Expect [b]UI improvements[/b], [b]balance adjustments[/b], and better overall [b]gameplay feel[/b] based on everything you shared during the beta.[/p][p][b]New Content & Systems[/b]
On top of polish, we’re adding new enemies and systems to deepen the challenge. One enemy we can reveal now is the [b]Snake Summoner[/b] — a sneaky foe who keeps their distance and retreats to a safe spot to summon Snake Shooters. Don’t let them get away![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45517908/43b12aa08a54cd161caab48b314acaba5773e2ae.gif"][/img][/p][p]That’s it for now — more updates coming soon!
Until then, stay sharp… the desert waits.[/p]

notes.title: Beta has ended!
notes.notes:
That’s a wrap!

The Horus: Desert Survivor Beta has come to an end, and we couldn’t be more grateful for the thousands of champions who stepped into the sands.

You fought corrupted gods, discovered ancient relics, and shaped your destiny one card at a time — and your feedback has been incredible.

What’s Next?

We're diving straight into development with your insights in hand. Expect updates, balance changes, and new features as we march toward the next step: demo release. This is just the beginning — the sands still have secrets to reveal.

Stay Connected

Make sure to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3269340/Horus_Desert_Survivor/]wishlist and follow[/url] the game to catch the next update.

Join our [url=https://subscribepage.io/RpvG0Z]Newsletter[/url] or hop into the [url=https://discord.gg/UmRy7SESQY]Discord[/url] to talk with the devs, share ideas, or just hang out with fellow survivors.

Thank you for helping bring Horus: Desert Survivor to life.
The journey continues… and Horus will return.

notes.title: Beta has Started!
notes.notes:
It’s time!

The Horus: Desert Survivor Beta has officially begun, and the desert calls for champions. Join us right now and be among the first to wield magical weapons, build powerful decks, and face the corrupted gods.

What’s Playable in the Beta?

[list]
[*]Explore the first floor of the campaign map
[*]Choose your path and build your deck
[*]9 magical weapons with unique effects
[*]Face 2 mini bosses and 6 distinct enemy types
[*]Collect and play with 30+ cards
[/list]

Your journey begins here – and your feedback will shape what comes next.

🗓️ When?
April 18–21
This is a limited-time beta — don’t miss your chance to be part of it!

🔑 How to Join?

Head to our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3269340/Horus_Desert_Survivor/]Steam page[/url] and click Request Access on the Playtest

Make sure to wishlist and follow the game!

Join our [url=https://subscribepage.io/RpvG0Z]Newsletter[/url] or [url=https://discord.gg/UmRy7SESQY]Discord [/url] to chat with the devs and boost your chances of future tests

We’re listening.
Every bit of feedback helps us sharpen the gameplay and balance the challenge. Share your thoughts on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3269340/Horus_Desert_Survivor/]Steam [/url] or [url=https://discord.gg/UmRy7SESQY]Discord [/url]— and thank you for helping bring Horus: Desert Survivor to life.

notes.title: Beta Is Coming!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We’re excited to announce that Horus: Desert Survivor is entering Beta – and we want YOU to join us in the sands!

What’s in the Beta?
- First floor of the campaign map, when travelling it you will pick your path and build your deck.
- 9 unique magical weapons to use
- 2 mini bosses
- 6 unique enemies
- Over 30 cards to find and use

Help shape the game with your feedback!

When?
🗓️ April 18-20
🕒 The gates will be open for a limited time – don’t miss out!

🔑 How to Join?
Make sure you’re following the game and have wishlisted it!
We’ll be sending out beta keys via:

Steam Playtest 
Our [url=https://subscribepage.io/RpvG0Z]Newsletter  [/url]– join to increase your chances and talk directly with the devs!

We Need Your Feedback!
This beta is all about refining the gameplay and balancing the challenge. Your voice matters – share your experience, bugs, and suggestions on our [url=https://discord.gg/UmRy7SESQY]Discord [/url] or Steam forums.

notes.title: Hey, everyone! Welcome to Horus: Desert Survivor!
notes.notes:
Hello, everyone!

We'd like to extend our warmest welcome to everyone new, and also to those who have been following our game from its early stages. It's great to have you here.

We are aiming to actively post developer updates here! So follow us if you're curious about the game, and how it's going.

Please consider wishlisting our game if you haven't already -- it lets us know how much interest there is, and helps the game gain visibility.

Thank you for joining us!
Emilijus Games
